rows.grounds: compound of sva, liṅga, guda, mūrdhan, āsya, nāsā, netra in locative plural indicating bodily sites
indeclinable adverb indicating all directions or all sides

items.question: Which additional bodily sites require placement to be performed in all directions?
premises: The verse specifies a series of bodily locations for placement.
These locations include one's own genitals, anus, head, mouth, nose, and eyes.
The placement at these locations is directed to occur on all sides.
items.inference: Placement is to be extended comprehensively across these specified bodily sites.
items.plain_english: One should place them in one's own genitals, anus, head, mouth, nose, and eyes, on all sides.
